name: gograph
description: Local AST-aware Go repository analysis for coding agents. Provides 66 query, analysis, and workflow capabilities (70 MCP endpoints including session lifecycle), including bounded first-call exploration, call graphs, reverse test attribution, runnable test selection for a change, coverage-profile gaps, stable identities, impact, interfaces, type usage, security-flow candidates, architecture policies, diagrams, error flow, and local workflow telemetry.
author: ozgurcd
